text: ok uh the basic cut needs to mirror when mirror edits is on i keep forgetting and then realize like several cuts down the line and its not so fun to go fix
resolution: Implemented armed Mirror Edit behavior for bounded Basic Cut in the active editor host. The clicked face now supplies the popup direction, offset phase, and retained selection first; then the cut-only mask expands through the existing positional mirror-twin authority, respecting the fixed model-origin plane and current Outliner scope. Both sides preview, commit, and undo in one journal transaction, while ordinary Loop Cut remains unchanged. Added a Zig regression covering a clicked face whose mirrored twin has earlier triangle IDs and proving cut stations appear on both sides; updated the Agent Seat contract. Verified with Zig 0.16 formatting, the full test-mesh-edit target (179 tests), and a ReleaseFast editor ship. Changes remain uncommitted because all touched framework test/host files contain unrelated in-flight worker edits.
